article.title: Forest left frustrated as winless run goes on after draw at Ipswich
article.summary: Nottingham Forest ended a run of three successive league defeats but endured another night of missed chances as they drew 1-1 at Ipswich Town in the Premier League, but the result does move the away side out of the relegation zone on goal difference.
